name: JK Enkou Sai
source:
The protagonist, Matsumae Kenji, a middle aged man with a beer belly, went to satisfy his lust in a sex service place, but then one girl called him out and said:

"Hey mister, if you've got some cash, won't you support me?"

That was an invitation to a so-called "compensated dating". Answering "OK" in a confused manner, she happily took Kenji with her to a love hotel. In there, time passed surrealistically. 

"If I'm gonna have sex, then it will be obviously better to do it with cute and young girls."

After experiencing sex with a high school girl, Kenji thought that prostitutes who pretend to be around 20 years of age can no longer satisfy him, and thus he decided to build compensated relationships with various high school girls...

[Translated from [url=http://currant.jp/jkenkousai/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公松前健二是个挺着啤酒肚的中年男人。他去风俗店满足欲望，却被一个女孩搭话：

“喂，大叔，如果你有钱的话，要不要资助我？”

这是所谓“援助交际”的邀请。健二迷迷糊糊地答应后，女孩开心地带他去了爱情旅馆。在那里，时间以超现实的方式流逝。

“既然要做，那当然还是和可爱年轻的女孩做比较好。”

和女高中生体验过性爱后，健二认为那些假装20岁左右的妓女再也无法满足自己，于是决定和各种女高中生建立援助关系……

[译自[url=http://currant.jp/jkenkousai/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
